```{r Heatmap, fig.path = '../docs/figure/'}
# Tested on R Version 4.4.2 
# ggplot2 Version 3.5.2
# WDI Version 2.7.9
# dplyr Version 1.1.4
# viridis Version 0.6.5
# forcats Version 1.0.0 
# stringr Version 1.5.1

# Install and load packages ---------------
packages <- c("WDI", 
              "dplyr", 
              "ggplot2", 
              "viridis",
              "tidyr",
              "forcats",
              "stringr")

# Change to install = TRUE to install the required packages
pacman::p_load(packages, character.only = TRUE, install = FALSE)

# Load an example dataset // Query from the World Bank API ---------
# https://databank.worldbank.org/source/world-development-indicators

indicators <- c(
  rural = "EG.ELC.ACCS.RU.ZS", # Access to electricity (% of rural population) 
  urban = "EG.ELC.ACCS.UR.ZS" # Access to electricity (% of urban population)
)

elec_data <- WDI(
  country = "all",    # or e.g., c("US", "IN", "CN")
  indicator = indicators,   
  start = 2000,
  end = 2023,
  extra = TRUE        # adds region, income level, etc.      
)

# Clean -------------------------
elec_plot_data <- elec_data %>%
  filter(region != "Aggregates") %>%
  select(income, year, rural, urban) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rural), !is.na(urban)) %>%
  group_by(income, year) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rural = mean(rural, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_urban = mean(urban, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(avg_rural, avg_urban), 
               names_to = "area", values_to = "access") %>%
  mutate(area = str_replace(area, "avg_", "")) %>%
  filter(income != "Not classified") %>%
  group_by(income, area) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(
    baseline_access = first(access[!is.na(access)]),
    change_from_baseline = access - baseline_access
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(change_from_baseline)) %>%
  ungroup()

income_order <- elec_plot_data %>%
  group_by(income) %>%
  summarise(total_change = max(change_from_baseline, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_change)) %>%
  pull(income)

# Plot ------------------------------
ggplot(elec_plot_data %>% mutate(income = factor(income, levels = income_order)), 
       aes(x = income, y = year, fill = change_from_baseline)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~area) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#000080", mid = "#8B008B", high = "#FFD700", 
                       midpoint = -15, name = "% Change\nfrom 2000") +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Electricity Access by Income Group (2000-2023)",
    subtitle = "Percentage point change from baseline year",
    x = "Income Group", y = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
